result.paraphrase: RT Cores: Dedicated ray-tracing hardware delivers fast real-time ray tracing for objects and environments, with physically accurate shadows, reflections, refractions, and global illumination. Concurrent Floating Point and Integer Processing: Turing GPUs handle the compute-intensive workloads of modern games more efficiently. Ultra-fast GDDR6: Up to 496 GB/s of memory bandwidth for high-speed, high-resolution gaming. Axial-tech fan design features a smaller fan hub that enables longer blades and a barrier ring that boosts downward air pressure. 0dB Technology lets you enjoy light gaming in near silence. Auto-Extreme Technology uses automation to improve reliability. Super Alloy Power II includes premium alloy chokes, solid polymer capacitors, and an array of high-current power stages. MaxContact Technology allows 2X more contact with the GPU chip for better thermal transfer. Aura Sync compatibility lets you customize and synchronize lighting effects with other compatible hardware. Evasione ordine 3/5 giorni lavorativi
